verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own marketing says its AI Assistant turns any prompt, link, or file into a polished video. Iterating on the result is only implied by generic mentions of editable videos (for PPT imports) and team editing workflows. Nothing documents refining a prompt-generated video without regenerating it. Missing for 10: documented iteration or refinement of prompt-generated output (e.g., re-prompting or editing scenes in place), in-depth docs on the prompt-to-video workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
